sample_unit: participants retained (pregnant or postpartum women of color)
models_evaluated: Rosie (question-and-answer chatbot using a curated knowledgebase)
unlisted_practices: Chatbot detects possible health emergencies, sends hotline resources, and a clinical social worker follows up within 24 hours (described but not tested)

screen.reason: Evaluates a patient-facing health QA chatbot (Rosie) with maternal/infant health outcomes in a randomized pilot study. While emergency detection and clinician follow-up are built in, the study evaluates the tool overall vs. control rather than comparing outcomes with vs. without a specific deployment practice.
